description: To apply for a Japanese tourist visa, submit the required documents and information, including proof of address, travel plans, and financial means.

requirements.name: Proof of Address
requirements.description: A utility bill or bank statement showing your current address, dated within 3 months.
requirements.validation_hints: The document must be issued within the last 3 months and show your current address.

requirements.name: Travel Plans
requirements.description: A confirmed flight itinerary or travel agency documents showing your travel plans.
requirements.validation_hints: The travel plans must be confirmed and show the dates of your trip.

requirements.name: Financial Means
requirements.description: Proof of sufficient financial means to support yourself during your stay in Japan.
requirements.validation_hints: The financial means must be sufficient to cover your stay in Japan.
